{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Identify rows with missing flipper_length_mm
missing_flipper = df[df['flipper_length_mm'].isnull()]

# Check species distribution of missing values
missing_by_species = missing_flipper['species'].value_counts().sort_index()
print('Missing flipper_length_mm by species:\n', missing_by_species)

# Also check total counts per species for context
total_by_species = df['species'].value_counts().sort_index()
print('\nTotal penguins by species:\n', total_by_species)"}
